label: Bible Study
prompt: My God, my God, why hast thou _____ me? why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?
verse: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?
note: The cry Jesus prayed from the cross — a psalm that ends, remarkably, in praise.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Rejoice, and be exceeding _____: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.
verse: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.
note: Jesus tells persecuted disciples to be 'exceeding glad' — they're in fine company with the prophets.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the city lieth _____, and the length is as large as the breadth: and he measured the city with the reed, twelve thousand furlongs. The length and the breadth and the height of it are equal.
verse: And the city lieth foursquare, and the length is as large as the breadth: and he measured the city with the reed, twelve thousand furlongs. The length and the breadth and the height of it are equal.
note: The new Jerusalem lies foursquare — its length, breadth, and height all equal.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But the word is very _____ unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it.
verse: But the word is very nigh unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it.
note: God's word isn't up in heaven or across the sea — Paul quotes this in Romans 10.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that _____ in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:
verse: We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:
note: Scripture as a lamp that 'shineth in a dark place' until the day dawns and the day star rises in your heart.
